svg.aria-label: DataForSEO Agent cost guard: every DataForSEO API call stops at the gate with its price. The free /dfs-balance call passes without a prompt, paid SEO calls wait for YES and fill the session budget meter, and the call that would cross the $1.00 budget is blocked with Session budget reached while the bots stop politely.
